history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache  && apk add --no-cache rspamd=4.0.1-r0 ca-certificates python3  && apk info -v > /etc/rspamd/packages.txt # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path; import shutil; [(shutil.copyfile(p, Path("/etc/rspamd/local.d") / (p.name if p.name.startswith("worker-") else p.stem+".conf"))) for p in Path("/opt/oo-filter").glob("*.inc")]' # buildkit
